# Sip N Snack Co.

> Sip N Snack Co. supplies made-to-order edible beverage cups to business buyers in Toronto, the GTA, Ontario, Canada and the USA. Product specifications and availability must be confirmed before ordering.

Website: https://www.sipnsnackco.ca/
Contact: sipnsnack786@gmail.com

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.sipnsnackco.ca/): Business overview and inquiries.
- [Edible cups](https://www.sipnsnackco.ca/edible-cups): Product information and evaluation.
- [Wholesale](https://www.sipnsnackco.ca/wholesale): Wholesale inquiries and supply.
- [Distributors](https://www.sipnsnackco.ca/distributors): Distribution inquiries.
- [Events](https://www.sipnsnackco.ca/events): Catering and events.
- [Buying guide](https://www.sipnsnackco.ca/cup-buying-guide): Business purchasing considerations.
- [Sitemap](https://www.sipnsnackco.ca/sitemap.xml): Published site pages.

## Important notes
Images may be illustrative. Do not infer certifications, ingredients, allergen status, cup capacity, environmental claims, production location or flavour availability from images. Confirm current product details with Sip N Snack Co.
